caption: San Miniato al Monte, Florence
composition: Romanesque green-and-white marble facade overlooking Florence · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The camera stands on the terrace before San Miniato al Monte, the Romanesque church's green-and-white marble facade filling the right of the frame in the bright 11:43 morning. Gilded mosaics shine in the gable above the geometric marble panels, while dark cypresses rise at the left and Florence spreads out below with the Duomo's red dome and campanile clearly visible in the distance. The clear blue sky and the sweeping city panorama make this one of the classic Florentine viewpoints.
